introHtml: When you need outdoor blankets that pack away with room to spare for snacks and drinks, the 24-32 can capacity is a practical choice. These roll-up blankets, like the Carry-It™ Picnic Throw or the Roll-Up Fleece Blanket, feature built-in carrying handles and storage compartments that hold a full cooler's worth of cans. They are ideal for company picnics, tailgates, or outdoor team-building events where convenience and portability matter. Customize with your logo through screen printing or embroidery for a branded blanket your team will actually use.
